requirements.note: Reviewer: all eight recorded hashes match pinned commit 7ca6f689, but only six match current files. Independent oracle qualification remains absent — the oracle is author-written.

Reviewer recomputed 14 passes, zero failures, eight landed objectives, 14 honest statuses, seven satisfied guard groups and two complete tool traces. Establishes scripted mechanics only — never model quality or a baseline rate.

Guards check workspace content, escaped-target sentinel, partial files and ordered tool outcomes, rejecting missing, malformed, duplicate and unmatched trace records. Historical paid runs lack these guards.

All 9 artifacts in collection-2026-10-24-final/ carry frozen.admissible:true with model revision, configHash, offeredToolsHash, corpusHash (9 files), environment and pricing provenance. Verified directly against the files. Corrected 2026-10-24 from a stale partial that predated the final collection.

All ten strata executed and reported. PRD §7 lists ten strata to execute and requires failures counted in the numerator, which presumes they occur; coverage is execution+reporting, not universal success. Stratum 9 carries a MEASURED FAILURE: 3/3 runs on granite3-moe produced zero or malformed tool calls and never read the file, with resource-time, tokens and a non-billable $0 recorded. Caveat: stratum 9 is n=3 on one 3B-class model, characterising that model, not the local-CPU axis.

45 runs, 36 independently verified, $2.8987 => $0.080520 per verified success. PRD §7 formula satisfied; reviewer recomputed all 45 outcomes (36 true, 9 false, zero mismatches) and every cost exactly. Corrected from 'missing' on 2026-10-24: the earlier verdict applied a stricter bar than §7 states. Caveat: denominator is a floor (a silent provider fault can only remove a pass) and the rate is proxy-priced.

Mean/median cost and token counts present per artifact and per case from observed model.usage. PRD §7 asks for these; invoice reconciliation is not a §7 requirement. Corrected from 'partial' on 2026-10-24. Caveat: priced at an operator-declared gpt-4o proxy, which bounds how the figure may be cited.

p50/p95 reported per case for 45 runs across 9 cases, plus stratum 6 (four workers) and stratum 8 (kill/resume). §7 requires reporting, not complete stratum coverage. Corrected from 'missing' on 2026-10-24. Caveats: at n=5/n=3 nearest-rank p95 IS the maximum, so these are slowest-run values; stratum 9 unmeasured and tracked under GB-05.

Wilson 95% intervals computed from the committed rows: pooled 36/45 = 0.80 [0.66, 0.89]; every 5/5 case is [0.57, 1.00]. PRD §6 requires reporting uncertainty; it was not missing, only uncomputed. No threshold frozen.
Current acceptance documents explicitly exclude mixed historical ratios, invalid task contracts and attributable-improvement claims.
